overview: Finding Neverland is a 2004 biographical drama film, directed by Marc Forster and written by David Magee, based on the 1998 play The Man Who Was Peter Pan by Allan Knee. It depicts the life of British author and playwright J. M. Barrie and the family who inspired him to create Peter Pan. The film stars Johnny Depp, Kate Winslet, Julie Christie, Radha Mitchell, and Dustin Hoffman.
